title: Biomass register — September 2026: generation 2025 ahead of usual (+11 % weight), −4 % stock left; 6 kg+ expected 12.9 % in October
lines: Harvest in September 2026: 172 kt gutted (+15 % on September 2025), average fish 4.10 kg (4.06 a year earlier). Biomass at sea 788 kt gutted (−0.2 %), 89 % of the MTB (zones 1–13, live weight).
Generation 2025, being harvested: 3.28 kg gutted on average, +11 % against the same generation stage of the past 5 years (ahead of usual); 514 kt gutted left at sea, −4 %.
Generation 2026, next in line: 0.94 kg gutted on average, +13 % against the same generation stage of the past 5 years (ahead of usual).
Mortality: 1.12 % of the stock in the month (1.07 % a year earlier).
Sizes expected (share of harvest volume): October 2026: 6 kg+ 12.9 %, 5–6 kg 18.1 %; November 2026: 6 kg+ 14.8 %, 5–6 kg 19.3 %.
